stages.title: Stage 0 · T2I 出底图（不挂板）
stages.prompt:
[1 身份锚]
C01 Jiang Chi: flat brow bones; short tousled black hair; white tee under an open light-grey school jacket

[2 本镜正文]
Over her blurred shoulder; Jiang Chi stands with his weight on his back foot; he glances toward the corridor window; third-floor corridor with terrazzo floor and steel-framed windows in sequence; medium shot, slightly low angle; only this instant, no motion result

[3 画风句]
Clean cel-shaded anime comic frame; crisp outlines; flat color blocks; restrained hard-edge shadows; consistent school-corridor palette

[4 约束]
16:9 landscape; no speech bubbles, no subtitles, no text, no logo, no panel lines, no watermark; no extra persons; if two characters share the frame they face each other left and right, never side by side
